description: NFC and full case folding by Unicode 15.1 alone (events phase A plan, decision 2; design D5): CaseFolding's C and F mappings, never S or T, and foldForComparison as NFC then folding. The conformance files themselves are derived from their pinned sources by test/support/conformance-sources.ts.

vectors.name: UNICODE_VERSION is 15.1.0
CND-e: ß folds to ss (F)
CND-e: capital sharp s ẞ folds to ss (F, not S's ß)
CND-e: İ folds to i + COMBINING DOT ABOVE (F), never the Turkic i (T)
CND-e: I folds to i (C), never the Turkic dotless ı (T)
CND-e: capital sigma Σ folds to σ
CND-e: small sigma σ is already folded
CND-e: final sigma ς folds to σ
CND-e: KELVIN SIGN folds to k
CND-e: ANGSTROM SIGN folds to å
CND-e: Cherokee small ꭰ folds to capital Ꭰ (folding goes to upper case there)
CND-e: the ligature ﬁ folds to fi (F)
CND-e: a whole string
CND-e: an astral capital, DESERET 𐐀, folds to 𐐨
a surrogate without its partner passes through
UNI-e: U+A7CB, assigned in Unicode 16, folds to itself under 15.1 (a 16 host lower-cases it to U+0264)
folding alone does not normalise: e + COMBINING ACUTE stays two
CND-e: foldForComparison normalises first: E + COMBINING ACUTE becomes é
CND-e: e + COMBINING ACUTE and é are the same for comparison
CND-e: but not under folding alone
CND-e: STRASSE and straße compare equal
CND-e: ANGSTROM SIGN and A + COMBINING RING ABOVE compare equal
CND-e: İ and i do not compare equal
NFC composes e + COMBINING ACUTE
NFC orders marks canonically, then composes: a + dot below + circumflex is ậ
NFC composes Hangul arithmetically: ᄀ + ᅡ + ᆨ is 각
NFC leaves a precomposed Hangul syllable
NFC never composes an exclusion: क़ stays क + nukta
NFC replaces a singleton: OHM SIGN is Ω
NFC leaves ASCII as it is
NFC of the empty string
a surrogate without its partner passes through NFC
